stem: Which statement is supported by this cladogram?

options.label: A
options.text: Hippopotamuses are more closely related to cows than to javelinas.

options.label: B
options.text: Toothed whales are more closely related to mouse deer than to hippopotamuses.

options.label: C
options.text: Javelinas and pigs are more closely related than baleen whales and toothed whales.

options.label: D
options.text: Cows and mouse deer are more closely related than javelinas and pigs.

visual_elements: Cladogram showing relationships: Baleen whale and Toothed whale branch together; Hippopotamus branches next; Cow and Mouse deer branch together; Javelina and Pig branch together.
